subject: Remove gray label ribbon from facet plots

messages.author: a0e82b98c8b5b862
messages.subject: Remove gray label ribbon from facet plots
parts:
ggplot2 crew,

I am trying to remove the gray ribbon from a facet plot so that I still have the three plots faceted but without the gray label.  I am attaching two pdfs, one is the normal facet plot created using ggplot2 (draws1), and the other is a plot created using base graphics which roughly what I would like (draws2).  I am also placing my code below on how I made the facet plot with ggplot2 and am also attaching the data (if you are curious the data is simulated draws from posterior densities using MCMC.)  Is this possible and if so how?  I thank you ahead of time for your help

Brian

draws1 <- read.table("your directory\\paperex1.txt",
                     header = F)
colnames(draws1) <- c("Iteration","draw")
draws1$par <- c(rep("mu",15000),rep("sigma[P]",15000),rep("sigma",15000))

qplot(Iteration,draw,data = draws1,geom = "line",ylab = "Posterior Draws") + facet_grid(par~.,scale = "free",labeller = label_parsed) + theme_bw()

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: Remove gray label ribbon from facet plots
parts:
Hi Brian, 

If I understand correctly you want to do the following. 

draws1 <- read.table("/Users/bhurr/Desktop/paperex1.txt", header = F)

qplot(Iteration,draw,data = draws1,geom = "line",ylab = "Posterior Draws") + facet_grid(par~.,scale = "free",labeller = label_parsed) + theme_bw() + opts(strip.background = theme_rect(colour = 'NA', fill = 'NA'))

From: http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Faceting-Attributes

Brandon

messages.subject: Re: Remove gray label ribbon from facet plots
parts:
Very close yes thanks.  This was actually more what I wanted (though you gave me exactly what I described):

qplot(Iteration,draw,data = draws1,geom = "line",ylab = "Posterior Draws") + facet_grid(par~.,scale = "free") + theme_bw()+
opts(strip.background = theme_rect(colour = 'NA', fill = 'NA'))+
opts(strip.text.y = theme_text(colour = 'white'))

Sorry I thought I searched that webpage, I guess there is more to it than I thought.

Brian
